messages:
maria: Thinking about an automatic fallback when a primary model is saturated (queue depth / GPU mem / throttles). Route to a compatible variant automatically. Goals: keep apps online, avoid quality surprises. Thoughts?

omar: +1 but we need safe heuristics. Prefer variants with same tokenizer and similar topology. Also need quality checks (eval sets / spike tests) before routing.

aisha: How do we detect saturation? We already emit queue_depth, instance_util, and request_reject metrics. Are we using reject_rate or p95 queue time?

lee: Product asks for telemetry: per-customer fallback rate, per-route fallback breakdown, and regression alerting when fallback correlates with quality drops. Console should surface when fallbacks exceed X% for >Y mins.

maria: Proposal sketch: Policy tiers: strict (prod) only fallback to vetted, bit-identical variants; relaxed (dev) allow quantized/cheaper variants. Trigger when primary.last_5m_reject_rate > 2% OR primary.queue_time_p95 > 300ms. Cooldown per-customer 10m.

omar: Important: use rejection signals, not transient pkts. Avoid rerouting on occasional spikes. Also we must prevent routing loops across regions/tiers. Implement a hop_count / origin_variant header.

aisha: Ops: add metric label fallback_reason (capacity|latency|error) and variant_used label. Also emit audit log entry for every fallback event for forensicability.

maria: UX: in console rollout page show fallback incidents alongside canary metrics. Allow manual opt-out per model or per-customer. Add API flag allow_auto_fallback (default true).

lee: Billing question: if fallback uses cheaper variant, how do we bill? We need token-level attribution: primary_attempted vs variant_served. Can runtime tag responses?

omar: Yes — runtime will tag responses with headers and tracing: X-variant-used, X-primary-attempted: true, and span attributes variant_hash. Billing can consume those.

maria: Draft policy schema example for the API / infra:
```
policy: "strict"
thresholds: {"queue_p95_ms":300, "reject_pct":2.0}
cooldown_s: 600
allowed_variants: ["v1-bit-identical","v1-8bit-safe"]
```

aisha: Ops alert proposal: fallback_rate > 5% sustained over 10m -> page SRE. Also create a dashboard tile: fallback_rate by customer tier, by region, and by route.

infra-bot: Feature branch 'auto-fallback' built and deployed to staging. Link: https://ci/internal/auto-fallback-build-412

lee: Can we run an internal beta with 5 pilot customers and measure regressions against saved eval sets? :eyes:

maria: I'll write an RFC with telemetry spec + console mockups + rollout plan. Assigning implementation estimates to @omar and @aisha. Will include a checklist: unit tests, chaos test (force saturations), billing integration, and staging beta. Thanks everyone.
